summary: Iteration 3 testing — 13/13 new pytest cases pass (portfolio multipart+GridFS, public /api/portfolio/{id}, iCal export with date and weekday-fallback, SSE notifications stream with cross-user push trigger, AI rate-limit 20/h returning 429+Retry-After, booking message booking_id). Found and fixed 1 backend bug: SSE generator crashed with 'TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes' on the first matching notification — coerced last_seen_at and Mongo created_at to naive UTC. After fix, SSE notification frames emit within ~3s of message insert. Frontend smoke-tested: SSE EventSource opens on app load for both pro and homeowner; Inbox renders 'Add to Calendar' button with data-testid='ical-download-' on booking system messages; the booking system messages from iter3 backend tests (Wed 09:00-12:00 dated 2026-02-04 and Fri 14:00-16:00 weekday fallback) appear in homeowner messages thread; portfolio settings tab renders built from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL + /api/portfolio/ (no rendered images at test time because the iter3 portfolio test cleans up its uploads — verified the contract via API). Two pre-existing iter2 tests now fail as EXPECTED per the iter3 contract change: (a) test_classify_homeowner_plumbing → 429 because iter3 rate-limit test consumed the hourly bucket (in-memory limiter — this is documented behavior in the request), and (b) test_upload_and_delete → 422 because iter2 still POSTs base64 JSON to /api/profile/pro/portfolio while iter3 now requires multipart/form-data. Both are intentional and called out by main agent.

minor.issue: FIXED in this run: SSE generator crashed comparing tz-aware last_seen_at with tz-naive Mongo datetime, silently terminating the stream before yielding 'event: notification'. Coerced both sides to naive UTC.

action_items: Acknowledge the 2 expected iter2 regressions: rate-limit budget exhaustion + portfolio base64→multipart contract change. Suggest updating iter2 test_upload_and_delete to use multipart, or deleting it in favor of the iter3 portfolio coverage.
Optional: the PortfolioUpload pydantic model in models.py is unused after iter3 — safe to remove to reduce confusion.
critical_code_review_comments: misc_routes.notifications_stream had a tz comparison bug that would terminate the stream silently on the first notification. Fixed by coercing both ends to naive UTC. Consider a small unit test on _booking_datetime + the SSE generator to catch this kind of regression.

rate_limit.py is in-memory only — production multi-pod deployment will under-count and effectively allow N×limit per hour. Backed by an explicit comment, but worth turning into a TODO with Redis fallback.
misc_routes.serve_portfolio_photo reads full file into memory before responding. Fine for ≤5MB but consider streaming via StreamingResponse for larger limits later.
PortfolioUpload pydantic model is imported in misc_routes but no longer referenced anywhere (iter3 replaced base64 endpoint with multipart). Remove to keep the public API surface clean.

success_rate.backend: 100% on iter3 (13/13). Full suite: 54/56 = 96.4% — 2 expected iter2 regressions documented above.
success_rate.frontend: 100% on the 3 critical iter3 flows verified (SSE on load, Add to Calendar button on bookings, portfolio image URL contract).

rca_of_the_issue: SSE stream silent-fail: last_seen_at was created with timezone.utc (tz-aware) while Mongo's motor driver returns datetime fields as tz-naive UTC. The 'last_seen_at = max(...)' inside the inner for-loop raised TypeError which Starlette swallowed via TaskGroup, closing the stream. Symptoms: clients see 'event: hello' + a single ': keep-alive' then nothing, with 200 status. Fix: normalize both to naive UTC. Reproduction: open EventSource as pro@test.com, then trigger a notification by POSTing /api/messages homeowner→pro_user_id; with the bug, no 'event: notification' frame appears. With the fix, the frame arrives within ~3s (polling interval).
